title: Leads Marketplace
theme: Profolio 2.0, extended to a new page — borrowed tokens, [TBC] designer sign-off

states.title: Owner Leads
states.notes: Owners from Sell with Bayut who want an agent. One field per column; the contact stays blurred until your agency buys the lead.
try: Filter by city: Abha has no leads
Row 3 is already bought by your agency — View in TruLeads
The last two leads came without rooms, district or price — see how each shows
Switch the locked-contact option (A/B/C) under Options

states.title: Seeker Leads
states.notes: Buyers and tenants from Find My Property: what they look for, their budget and where.

states.title: First visit
states.notes: The first time an agent opens the page: what the marketplace is and how buying works. Dismissed once, it never comes back.

states.title: Filtered
states.notes: Filters apply at once; the tab count stays the total, the table shows what matches.

states.title: No results
states.notes: Leads exist, none match: say so and offer to clear the filters.

states.title: Buy dialog
states.notes: The summary, the price in credits, the balance (a staff member's is their limit) and the no-refund rule.

states.title: Bought
states.notes: Credits are deducted; the row unblurs, turns green and says who bought it; View in TruLeads opens the lead.

states.title: Not enough credits
states.notes: Opens instead of the buy dialog when the balance is under the price. Top up opens the existing credit top-up.

states.title: Over the staff limit
states.notes: A staff member whose credit limit is under the price: the existing cap rule, in the product's words [TBC].

states.title: Taken meanwhile
states.notes: The last spot went, or the lead expired, while the dialog was open: nothing is charged and the row greys out.

states.title: Loading
states.notes: Skeleton rows built from the table's own row, so they follow its columns.

states.title: No leads
states.notes: No open leads in the tab: say they arrive through the day.

states.title: Error
states.notes: The list failed to load: Try again reloads it.

kinds.loading: not drawn: the Buy button shows its own loading while the purchase runs
kinds.empty: not drawn: always holds the lead it opened for

kinds.loading: not drawn: the city list ships with the page
kinds.empty: not drawn: the 13 regions always exist
